goal: Remove the default transcript-grader recommendation from the /task skill template so generated tasks no longer auto-suggest a per-task turn budget.

constraints: Drop the `{ "type": "transcript", "max_turns": 30, "name": "budget" }` line from the 'Fully briefed task' example block in .claude/commands/task.md.
Keep the transcript row in the 'Grader types' table as an opt-in option; only the example/recommendation should change.
If any narrative copy elsewhere in the file frames transcript as a recommended default, soften it to opt-in language; do not invent new prose.
Do not change the example task JSON structure beyond removing the transcript grader line (and adjusting a trailing comma if JSON-in-fenced-block syntax requires it).
Commit the change with a Conventional Commits message (e.g. 'docs:') before reporting verify.
non_goals: Do not edit any other slash-command template.
Do not retroactively rewrite tasks already in .workflow/tasks/active/ or .workflow/tasks/archive/.

graders.run: ! awk '/### Fully briefed/,/### Grader types/' .claude/commands/task.md | grep -q '"type": "transcript"'
graders.name: example-block-clean

graders.run: awk '/### Grader types/,/### Authoring discipline/' .claude/commands/task.md | grep -q 'transcript'
